display.purpose: A page title on a large screen.

headline.purpose: The heading of a single-purpose page, such as login and setup.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a screen, such as Play. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--muted); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Only for what cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: var(--destructive); color: var(--destructive-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled field with its error message.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-input { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--destructive); } .ds-field-error { color: var(--destructive); font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised panel: one tonal step up, a border, no shadow.
components.html:
The Dark Knight (2008)

2h 32m · Action, Crime
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1rem; font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .ds-card-meta { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }

components.name: Poster with scrim
components.description: Text over artwork sits on the overlay at 75% or stronger.
components.css: .ds-poster { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; width: 12rem; margin: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(var(--warning), var(--primary)); } .ds-poster-caption { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 3rem 0.75rem 0.75rem; color: var(--overlay-foreground); background: linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in oklab, var(--overlay) 90%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, var(--overlay) 75%, transparent) 50%, transparent); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The room goes dark so that the screen can glow. ShowStream's interface is a cool, near-black frame around posters and backdrops, which supply all the color a screen needs. One warm amber, like the lights of a cinema marquee, marks the action that matters. Everything else steps back: tonal surfaces instead of shadows, muted text for metadata, and status colors only where a status is real.

Dark is the first theme, and light is complete rather than an afterthought. The theme follows the system unless the user picks one, and it applies before the first paint, so a reload never flashes.

The interface is an operating tool: people browse a library and press Play. Precision and consistency matter more than expression, and the brand lives in the accent, the type and the quiet.
keyCharacteristics: A cool neutral base at hue 265, in both themes.
One warm accent, used for the main action, links and focus.
Depth through tonal layers, never shadows.
Geist Sans for the interface and Geist Mono for technical data, served by the install itself.
Contrast checked by a test: 7:1 for body text on the page, 4.5:1 for every other text pair, 3:1 for status and focus.

rules.name: The One Warm Light Rule
rules.body: `primary` is the only warm color in the chrome. Use it for the main action of a screen and for focus, not for decoration, so that the eye finds Play first.

rules.name: The Poster Owns the Color Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay neutral at hue 265. Color comes from artwork, and from status only when there is a status to report.

rules.name: The One Place Rule
rules.body: The accent is the block marked "The accent" in `tokens.css`. Change it there, and `ring` and every accent use follow. The contrast test checks the result.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for measured values only, never for a "technical" look.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: To raise a surface, move it one step up the neutral scale and give it a border. Never add a shadow.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text over a poster sits on `overlay` at 75% or stronger, usually as a gradient from the bottom. At 75% over a white poster, `overlay-foreground` still reads at 4.5:1, which the contrast test checks. `overlay` at 25% only dims art, and carries no text.

dos: **Do** use the semantic utilities, such as `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground` and `border-border`, for every color.
**Do** show status with `success`, `warning`, `info` or `destructive`, paired with a word or icon, never color alone.
**Do** put text over artwork on `overlay` at 75% or stronger.
**Do** check new screens in both themes, at 390px and 1280px, by keyboard.
donts: **Don't** use raw colors such as `text-red-500`, hex values or `bg-black` in `apps/web`. A test fails on them.
**Don't** add shadows. Raise a surface with a tonal step and a border.
**Don't** add a second accent or tint surfaces with color.
**Don't** load fonts from a CDN. They ship with the app.
**Don't** set a `dark` class on anything but `<html>`, except to preview a theme. The theme provider owns it.
